description: UCI row 62 (age 61, MEDIUM vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 1, horizon 5yr) — em equity etf: soft fails ['R2', 'R3'] (score 65) -> CONDITIONAL
client_narrative: Riitta Mäkinen is 61 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 119,800 euros (around 9,983 euros per month). They hold 2,800 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 2,500 euros with a 5-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is very conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 1 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 2,500 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund tracking the MSCI Emerging Markets Index, providing exposure to equity markets across 24 emerging-market countries. The fund publishes a KID, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). Due to elevated market and currency risk, moderate financial knowledge is expected from investors. The recommended minimum holding period is seven years.
